description: SYNTHETIC role-play (invented, fictional people; written for testing). Short 8-minute session.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hello. I was told to come and talk about my pills.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks for coming. What would you like to say about taking your medicine?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I forget them a lot, mostly in the morning when I'm rushing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Mornings get busy and the pills slip your mind.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes. I want to take them though, I don't want a stroke like my uncle.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You've been looking after yourself by showing up today. Some people keep the pills next to the toothbrush.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That could work. My toothbrush is by the sink where I always stand.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Seeing the box when you brush your teeth could remind you. How does that sound to you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good. I'll put them there tonight.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You'll set it up tonight. We can see how it goes next time.
